capabilities: transcribe speech via StepFun ASR and send it to an LLM with vault tools
read, search, create, append, update, move, and open notes by voice
speak replies aloud via text-to-speech with barge-in support
answer questions beyond the vault via optional Tavily or Exa web search
trigger recording from any app through a local HTTP server and global hotkey
extras: Pending Obsidian community plugin review; the README recommends installing via BRAT in the meantime. Requires Obsidian 1.7.0+ on desktop. Audio, transcripts, and vault snippets are sent to StepFun, the chosen LLM provider, and optionally Tavily/Exa; API keys are stored in plaintext in data.json. Documentation is bilingual (English/Chinese).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to control the vault by voice, so hands-free querying and note-taking requires an external assistant.
